C-KEITARO-CLIENT-POOL-CACHE-20261118.Summary: Speed up Keitaro reads: one shared keep-alive httpx client for the app and a short TTL cache for the campaign and offer lists.
C-KEITARO-CLIENT-POOL-CACHE-20261118.Problem: GET /api/campaigns takes about 3 s because Keitaro returns all ~380 campaigns (about 235 KB, 3-5 s server time) on every search keystroke, and every request opens a new TLS connection.

Goals.Goal: One httpx.AsyncClient per process, created in the FastAPI lifespan and reused by get_keitaro_client (keep-alive, no per-request TLS handshake).
In-process TTL cache (KEITARO_CACHE_TTL_SECONDS, default 60) for list_campaigns and list_offers; the campaign cache is invalidated after the creator creates or rolls back a campaign.

Constraints.Constraint: No API contract change; editor stream/offer reads (get_stream, list_streams, report/build) are never cached.
Tests are banned; evidence is gates plus measured latency before/after.

NonGoals.NonGoal: No shared/distributed cache (Redis); no server-side pagination of Keitaro.

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: Second and later GET /api/campaigns within the TTL answer in well under 100 ms; a newly created campaign appears in the list immediately.
make gate-backend, gate-openapi (unchanged contract) and grace lint exit 0.

VerificationIntent.ExpectedEvidence: Gate output and curl timings of /api/campaigns before and after.

Assumptions.Assumption: Requested by the user in chat on 2026-11-18 ("кэш тоже делай"); a 60 s staleness for campaigns created outside this tool is acceptable.
